device.user_gone: This Homey user no longer exists.

settings.title: Which users count as "everyone"?
settings.intro: The "everyone" Flow cards look at the users ticked below, live, every time a Flow runs. A new Homey user is counted automatically, so you never have to edit a Flow after someone joins the household. Untick anyone who should not hold the whole house back — a guest account, or a phone that never reports presence.
settings.vacation_intro: A user on vacation is left out of the "everyone" cards, so those keep working for whoever is still around. Vacation can also be set from a Flow, or from the user's vacation device.
settings.vacation_auto_return: Clear vacation automatically when someone comes home
settings.one_home_awake: Exactly one at home is awake
settings.log_title: What the app has been doing
settings.log_intro: The most recent events, newest first — triggers that fired, vacation changes and any errors. Kept in memory only, so it is cleared whenever the app restarts and nothing is written to your Homey's storage.
settings.log_persist: Keep the log across app restarts
settings.disabled_note: An account that is disabled in Homey is never counted, whatever is ticked here — it cannot report where it is.
settings.statuses_intro: A status is a label you put on a person, and every status gets the same Flow cards: a trigger for taking it on or losing it, a condition, and an action to set it. Vacation and Do not disturb come with the app. Add your own for whatever your household needs.
settings.status_exclude: Leave holders out of the "everyone" cards
settings.status_auto_return: Clear it automatically when that person comes home
settings.status_none: No statuses of your own yet.
